data.action: 滑坐在长椅旁，双掌撑湿地面，制服保持整齐，看向画面外的同行者。
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level side three-quarter view, bracing hands and bench legs visible
data.description: 暴雨中的公交站避雨亭下，唯刚踩到一片积水，便滑坐在长椅旁，双手撑住湿水泥地面。水手制服领口与裙摆保持整齐，红色风纪袖章有几滴雨水。她看向画面外赶来帮忙的梨斗，又恼又窘——「结城梨斗！先别笑……这里的地面真的很滑！」长椅脚、排水槽和亭外雨帘交代落地点；檐下暖灯照脸与扶地的手，冷雨光和水洼反光延伸到街边。
data.lighting: warm shelter lamp from above left on face and hands; cool rain light beyond the roof
data.location: 雨夜公交避雨亭长椅旁，排水槽接向亭外街边
data.mood: 雨夜意外后的恼羞与松口气
data.promptProse: Rainwater crosses the drainage channel beside the bus shelter as Yui steadies herself after a small slip. She sits on the wet pavement near the bench, both palms flat on the ground and her sailor uniform lying neatly in place. Her red armband and white hairband remain visible as she looks toward a helper outside the frame with embarrassed annoyance. Bench legs and a shelter post anchor the near view; beyond the canopy, a dense rain curtain leads toward the street's reflected lights. Use an eye-level side three-quarter medium view that keeps face, hands and landing surface clear. The overhead lamp from the left warms her face and fingers, while cooler rain light outlines the far sleeve. Small palm shadows and reflections connect her hands to the wet concrete.
data.title: 古手川唯 · 雨夜站台的滑步惊魂
